newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Aeroflot, Continental code-sharing deal postponed.
newsitem.headline: Aeroflot, Continental code-sharing deal postponed.

text.p: Russian flag carrier Aeroflot said on Tuesday that a code-sharing deal with Continental Airlines of the United States would be postponed until 1998 because of delays in approving Continental's Russia flights.

Aeroflot chief executive Valery Okulov told a news conference the deal might come into effect only next April. "The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has not approved the start of regular flights to Russia for Continental Airlines. That's why we have postponed the agreement to next April," he said.
